theorem.closure: Both generated transition tables map every valid six-bit address back into the forty-state Pauli address space.
theorem.presentation: The hardware tables satisfy T^5=M^4=1 and M T M^-1=T^3 on all forty addressed nonidentity single-site qutrit Paulis.
theorem.interface: One opcode bit selects a total, deterministic F20 generator transition on valid addresses; invalid addresses fail closed.

negativeControl.mutation: Replace the Clifford-compensated multiplier by the identity transition.
negativeControl.purpose: Proves the order-four multiplier assertion is not vacuous and catches omission of the local Clifford compensation.

boundary: This proves the finite forty-address controller and its presentation. It is not a timing closure, physical qutrit device, threshold measurement, or fault-tolerant recode proof.
